summary: Interface-bound tumor expansion with explicit area and source contracts.

rules.claim: Every changed pixel must convert one declared source label to Tumor and no other pixel may change.
rules.required_observation: Compare source, target, and change region pixel by pixel.
counterexamples: Changing Normal epithelium because it lies near the selected polygon.

rules.claim: Every changed component must touch the selected pre-edit tumor/source interface and satisfy area, topology, depth/span, provenance, and profile checks.
rules.required_observation: Run all bound deterministic checks before critic review.
counterexamples: A remote tumor island created only to meet the area target.
